responsibility: This subtarget header configures the m68k backend for NetBSD on ELF. It defines NetBSD-specific preprocessor builtins, CPP/ASM/LINK specs, profiler call sequences, data-type sizes, long-double sizing for 68010 versus 68020+, debugger register numbering, ABI register choices for structure returns and static chains, and lifted ELF/SVR4-style assembler-output conventions such as jump tables, alignment, and BSS/common handling. It serves as the OS/ABI adaptation layer for NetBSD’s m68k ELF environment.
